resources.string: «Open in Telegram» adds this proxy to Telegram on this phone. Or copy the link, send it to yourself in Telegram and tap it.
For other devices on your network
Could not open Telegram. The link is copied to the clipboard: send it in Telegram and tap it.
Proxy port. Telegram proxy settings must use the same port
Secret key for client authorization. After a change, add the proxy to Telegram again
One rule per line, format: number:IP
Mapping of Telegram data center (DC) number to web.telegram.org dc server IP, e.g. 4:149.154.167.220. If connection fails then fallbacks are used
Use Cloudflare proxy for unreachable data centers
Specify your own domains instead of automatic selection
Your own domains proxied through Cloudflare for HTTP/2 and WS connections. Separate multiple domains with commas. If empty — chosen automatically from supported domains
Route connections to Telegram DCs through your own Cloudflare Worker
Cloudflare Worker domains (e.g. name.account.workers.dev). Separate multiple domains with commas. The proxy routes connections to Telegram DCs by IP through them
Disable TLS for CF-proxy and CF-worker
When enabled, the proxy will use port 80 for CF-proxy and CF-worker connections
Off: only apps on this phone can connect (127.0.0.1). On: other devices on your network can connect too (0.0.0.0)
Send all traffic to Telegram test DCs. Only for clients that report test DCs as plain 1–3 (Telethon, TDLib); regular accounts stop working through this proxy
How many ready WebSocket connections to keep per data center. 0 disables the direct DC→IP WebSocket route
Receive/send buffer size in kilobytes. A larger value allocates more memory per socket
Start the proxy in the background when the phone is turned on
When enabled, more details are written to the log — useful for troubleshooting
The changed settings have not been saved.
Port must be a number between 1 and 65535
Secret must be exactly 32 hex characters (16 bytes).
Secret must contain only hex characters (0-9, a-f).
Invalid domain: %1$s. Enter a name like example.com, without http:// or a path
Must be a number from %1$d to %2$d
Must be a number from %1$d to %2$d
Fix the highlighted fields to save.

Failed to start proxy:
Port %1$d is already in use by another application.

Close the app using this port, or change the port in proxy settings and restart.

Failed to start proxy:
Access to address/port denied.

Android apps cannot use ports below 1024: change the port to a random value in 10000–50000 in settings and restart.

Failed to start proxy:
Invalid or unavailable listen address.

Check «Listen on all interfaces» and the port in settings and restart.

Failed to start proxy: invalid settings.
%1$s

Fix it in Settings and start again.
Keeps the proxy running in the background
